field_mappings.note: Resolved to op.student's real id via the ir.model.data external ID the pipeline registered when it synced that student. Fails loudly if the student has not been synced yet.
Resolved to op.subject's real id via its external ID, then combined with exam_name/total_marks to get-or-create the shared op.exam record.
Not a field on op.exam.attendees. Identifies which shared op.exam this mark belongs to.
Lives on op.exam, not on the attendee row -- the paper is out of 50 regardless of who sat it.

unmapped_required_target_fields.note: Required selection (present/absent). PIEAS records a mark but not attendance, so 'present' is assumed -- a mark implies the student sat the paper. Disclosed assumption, set by the compiled default below rather than fabricated per record.
